cards.title: Iran adds demands as Hormuz reopening remains conditional
cards.summary: AP reports new Iranian conditions while a possible temporary route remains under discussion with Oman.
detail: AP reported on Aug. 8 that Iran had issued new demands around reopening the Strait of Hormuz, while the United Arab Emirates said one of its ships had been targeted by an Iranian missile. The development matters because the waterway remains a central security and energy risk. Earlier reporting described progress toward a temporary route with Oman, but the newer conditions show that progress is not the same as an operational reopening.

The next evidence is a confirmed agreement, clear navigation rules, and independently verified vessel movement. The parties' accounts may still differ on control, permissions, and what “open” means in practice.
